name: ceiling_guard_stays_silent_during_whf_ventilation__whf
description: [whole-house-fan twin of golden 'ceiling_guard_fires_when_outdoor_stays_below_indoor'; Issue #1193] Whole-house fan install: windows open, fan running, outdoor (68F) stays below indoor all afternoon but sun/internal gains push indoor to 76F, 2F over comfort_cool 74F. Owner decision 2026-11-01 (Issue #392 design confirmed): during WHF ventilation the ceiling guard must NOT escalate to air conditioning -- rule 2 (fan and HVAC never together) and rule 3 (no cooling with a window open). The fan keeps running and HVAC stays off. This replaces the hvac_fan 'guard fires AC' expectation, which is not created because it violates rule 3 (tracked in #1142).
source: Issue #1193: whole-house-fan twin of golden 'ceiling_guard_fires_when_outdoor_stays_below_indoor' (pre-#1140 version, fan configured). The golden is locked and now asserts the no-fan 'paused' result.
notes: Occupant experience this guards: on a mild/warm day CA opened the windows, the afternoon sun warmed the
house faster than the breeze cooled it, indoor sat at 76F (2F over the 74F ceiling) for hours, and the AC
never ran. This scenario fails on pre-fix code (ceiling guard goes dormant whenever outdoor<=indoor) and
passes once the dormancy requires outdoor<=indoor AND nat_vent_active AND indoor<=ceiling.
Distinct from warm_day_ceiling_breach_ac_defense (#136), where outdoor RISES above indoor and the guard
already fired correctly — that scenario masked the omission because its breach path crosses outdoor>indoor.
whole_house_fan twin (Issue #1193): with a whole-house fan configured, an open window with usable outdoor air runs the fan and suppresses HVAC (rule 2: fan and HVAC never together).
The hvac_fan mirror of this behaviour is NOT created: hvac_fan escalation to AC with windows open is the known rule-3 violation tracked in #1142 (D4/D7).

verdict.summary: With a whole-house fan running and outdoor below indoor, indoor above comfort_cool does not make the ceiling guard escalate to AC; the fan session continues and HVAC is never commanded to cool
verdict.observed_behavior: Production (v0.8.22): no ceiling_guard_fired / nat_vent_ceiling_escalation event at 15:30; fan stays on; last HVAC command is off
verdict.expected_behavior: Fan keeps running, AC is not started while the house is ventilated with windows open (Issue #392: for a WHF the guard has no ceiling term; switching to AC while outdoor < indoor caused an off/cool/off oscillation every ~5 minutes)

events.note: Warm-day classification: HVAC off. Indoor will be checked for nat-vent eligibility on sensor open.
Early afternoon: outdoor 68F below indoor 72F, indoor > comfort_heat 70F — nat-vent eligible.
User opens window per recommendation: outdoor 68F < indoor 72F, indoor > comfort_heat 70F, outdoor <= threshold 77F — nat-vent activates.

90 min later: outdoor STILL 68F (below indoor) but solar/internal gains drove indoor to 76F — 2F above comfort_cool=74F. ODE predicts indoor stays above the ceiling under continued nat-vent. Free cooling is losing; guard must escalate to AC.

assertions.reason: sensor_open: outdoor 68F < indoor 72F, indoor > comfort_heat 70F, outdoor 68F <= threshold 77F -- the whole-house fan starts and nat-vent activates (HVAC suppressed for the fan session).

Indoor 76F is 2F over comfort_cool 74F but outdoor is still 68F: the whole-house fan is still removing heat, so the decision stays natural_ventilation. An AC escalation would instead surface as ceiling_guard_fires_cool (the hvac_fan expectation), which Issue #392 and rules 2/3 forbid while the fan runs with windows open.
The ceiling guard must not clear the whole-house-fan session (it would on an hvac_fan install); the session is still active at the end of the scenario (final-state check).
Rule 2/3 guarantee: from the moment the fan starts (14:02) to the end of the run no climate command may select cool or heat -- the compressor never runs against the fan or an open window.
